prompt: Quiet still-life film for a museum design store. Locked-off camera with an extremely slow, smooth push-in. The pale green opaque glass bottle vase with its round dark green glass stopper stands perfectly still on the grey concrete shelf and never changes: same shape, same colours, same size, same position. Soft late-afternoon sunlight slowly drifts across the warm parchment wall: a crisp geometric window-frame shadow slides gently from left to right behind the vase, and a soft glint travels across the glossy glass stopper. Calm, minimal, gallery atmosphere. Sound: quiet room tone only.
negative: people, hands, text, logos, music, extra objects, flowers, the vase moving, the vase changing shape or colour, camera shake, fast motion
